narrative: The queen's line, and bare paper under the last sentence. The light has moved on the desk. Nothing new is written. At the left of the leaf, the older sheets, edges only. No number on the top edge. His hand is not on them. The verse and the question are both still as written. The pen has not come out of the rest.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Visible/present in Sat with the finished leaf and left the pen down
